description: This Java class defines a service called BreakableService that can be configured to simulate failures during its lifecycle events (init, start, stop) for testing purposes. It maintains counters for each lifecycle state and can throw a custom exception to simulate failures.

classes.name: BreakableService
classes.description: A service class that can be configured to fail on lifecycle events for testing failure handling.

classes.name: BrokenLifecycleEvent
classes.description: A RuntimeException subclass used to indicate a lifecycle failure during init, start, or stop.

methods.name: BreakableService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with optional failure flags.

methods.name: BreakableService
methods.description: Constructor with parameters to set failure flags for init, start, and stop.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a STATE enum to an integer index for the counts array.

methods.name: inc
methods.description: Increments the counter for a given lifecycle state.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times a specific lifecycle state has been entered.

methods.name: maybeFail
methods.description: Throws a BrokenLifecycleEvent if the fail flag is true.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the service, increments counter, and may fail based on configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service, increments counter, and may fail based on configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service, increments counter, and may fail based on configuration.
